title: Ignore quote-copy completion after blockquote unmount
outcome: MarkdownBlockquote awaits the clipboard promise and currently updates copied state even if the message or deferred Markdown subtree has unmounted. Guard stale async completion and add a regression test that resolves the clipboard promise after unmount.
